title: pebbles repo is not rustfmt-clean under current toolchains
description:
Decision (owner, approved 2026-09-23): all committed code must always be invariant to the current cargo fmt - `cargo fmt -- --check` must pass on the committed tree. Action: run a full format pass (cargo fmt) over the current base and land it. If the fmt toolchain changes so that cargo fmt would rewrite otherwise-unmodified committed code, or any other drift appears, do not pin a toolchain version or silently reformat: ask the user interactively what to do. Policy is documented in CONTRIBUTING.md (Code Style).

Context (first observed 2026-09-22 while landing a525f10c): pre-existing diffs in src/display.rs, src/main.rs, src/projects.rs that the a52 worker did not touch made worker gates trip on fmt. The drift has since grown: cargo fmt -- --check currently reports diffs across src/display.rs, src/operations.rs, src/projects.rs, src/storage.rs, src/tui.rs, and tests/.
